title: PI-H2T: Enhancing Long-Tailed Visual Recognition with Permutation-Invariant and Head-to-Tail Feature Fusion

evidence.finding: Paper specifies one 2-to-1 Conv1d: two weights, optionally a third bias. The retained local prototype has 25 parameters; author parity is not established.
Author discusses residual head-tail trade-offs and some head features assigned toward tail regions.
Overly strong fusion semantic noise is discussed. H2TF is not used at inference.
ECE and representation/classifier interaction are acknowledged limitations.
